title: System
subtitle: How this Aquarium works: the models, tools, skills and memory your agents use.
infoBody: Everything that powers your agents lives here. Open a card to see or change it; nothing on this page changes anything by itself.
adminView: You’re seeing the admin view. Core and the agent web browser are shown to admins only — everyone else sees them locked.
lockedBody: Ask the owner or an admin if you need something checked here.
settingsLead: Looking for your preferences, theme or integrations?

core.title: Core is for admins
core.body: Core shows the parts of Aquarium the agent can never change. Only the owner and admins can open it.

webview.title: The agent web browser is for admins
webview.body: It lets the agent drive real websites under your consent. Only the owner and admins can open it.

lockedPage.hint: Ask the owner if you need something checked.

advancedHelp: Shows the technical details engineers use: ids, file paths, scoring rules and raw states. It changes nothing, and this device remembers your choice.
hubAdvancedHelp: Also shows the pages engineers use: the goal graph and, for admins, Core and the agent web browser. It changes nothing, and this device remembers your choice.

core.subtitle: The parts of Aquarium agents can never change. Read-only.
core.infoBody: Core is a protected list of paths. Agents can never write to them; Core changes only through a reviewed change made by a person.
core.fallbackHelp: The protected-paths file couldn’t be read, so Aquarium is using its built-in safe list. Agents still can’t change Core.
core.pathsBody: Agents can never write these paths.
core.noBlocked: No blocked attempts — no agent has tried to change Core.
core.changelogOff: Change log not configured — it needs the application datastore.
core.noChanges: No changes visible in your scope.
core.readOnly: Read-only. Core is shown here, never changed.

graph.subtitle: The goals your agents work toward, the tasks under them and the skills they use. Read-only.
graph.infoBody: Each card is a goal with a 0–100 score. Tasks sit under their goal, with the skills they use. Sub-goals are nested one level in.
graph.notConfigured: The graph needs the application datastore. Set {dsn}, then create goals with {cmd}.
graph.empty: No goals visible in your scope yet.

models.subtitle: Which brains your agents use for each job, and how they’re doing.
models.infoBody: The main model answers chats and runs scheduled jobs. Helper roles do smaller jobs like titles or summaries; Auto uses the main model.
models.advancedHelp: Shows model family, context size, backup chains, every helper role and the per-call performance table. It changes nothing.
